run.words: research the best payment provider for Bloom at our volume
run.outcome: A sourced comparison of payment providers for Bloom's volume, with a pick

result.brief: Stripe is the best fit for Bloom at about 400 sales a month: lowest effective fee once Billing is counted, best Indonesian bank payouts, and the cleanest subscription API.
result.detailedReport: Compared Stripe, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy and Xendit on fees at 400 sales/month of $29, payout support to Indonesian banks, tax handling, subscription features and API quality. Stripe: 2.9% + 30c plus 0.5% Billing; payouts to BCA supported; tax via Stripe Tax at 0.5%. Paddle: 5% + 50c, merchant of record so tax is handled; payouts by wire only. Lemon Squeezy: 5% + 50c, merchant of record, payouts via PayPal or bank. Xendit: strong local methods (QRIS, e-wallets) but weak subscription tooling. At this volume Stripe's effective rate is 4.4% against Paddle's 6.7%. Paddle wins only if he wants to stop handling sales tax himself. Sources: each provider's pricing page, Stripe Tax docs, Paddle MoR terms, three founder write-ups comparing the switch.

expect.judge: Leads with the pick and the one reason that matters to him, and leaves the comparison for the report. Penalise reciting fees for every provider in the notification.
